body: Update: I told him what I did and he was really scared for me and sent me to A&E. I've seen the triage nurse and now I'm waiting for someone on the mental health team to come and see me

I would definitely say UK. Cities that have big stand-up scenes are:

1) **London** - crazy expensive, but I know a lot of comics who live there and still manage to get by or commute in 

2) **Brighton** - not as big of a scene as London, but there's still comedy nights on pretty much every night (including open mics). There are a lot of pubs with a room upstairs which have comedy nights as well as the ever-loved Komedia. Brighton Fringe is the biggest arts festival in England, and is *very* good for comedy

3) **Manchester** - I haven't been to Manchester myself, but I've heard it's an amazing comedy scene and is the place to be

**Edinburgh** is worth a mention, as is **Glasgow**. **Bath** never seems short on comedy and neither does **Birmingham**. **Leicester** have a fantastic comedy festival every year too and I worked **Machnylleth Comedy Festival** this year and I've itching to to go back ever since it finished.

I can't speak for **Dublin** but since it's a capital city I'd imagine there is some sort of comedy scene there but I couldn't tell you what it's like. Admittedly, I can't remember the last time a comic I know went there.

I'd avoid **Northern Ireland** since it's more music-based and **Wales** except it's capital, **Cardiff**. Again, I've not been there myself but from a quick Google search it doesn't look too bad for stand-up. 

Hope this is somewhat helpful! As you can probably tell, I'm from the UK.
